Before the death of my father, he deposited the sum of US$15,000,000.00(fifteen million United States Dollars) in a private security trust company for safe keeping only. All the related documents are intact with me and I have currently contacted the company. My younger sister and I are in Dakar Senegal as asylum seekers pending when I get a Foreign partner; because of the monetary laws here which do not allow asylum seekers to operate any bank account.
